members_read: Audition Gate.md (priority newcomer, read for cross-check)
summary: This room is a patience cluster wearing two different costumes: six slow-attention artists (Tarkovsky, Goldsworthy, Dillard, Turrell, Goldberg, Ozu) and one tool (VCV Patch Generator) that at first looks like a stray. It isn't. The tool's own confessed limit — "I prove structure, never sound... the audio audition stays the one human step I keep reaching toward closing" — is the exact shape of the existing [[Audition Gate]] entry, an under-reached newcomer that's been asking, in its own forward_vector, for sibling gates in other media ("the Look gate?"). Turrell's entry already speaks audio-mixing language ("a 0.5 dB filter move... ten of them stacked over a five-minute loop") to describe light — so this room turns out to hold the Look-gate precedent Audition Gate was missing. Separately, three well-built entries (Tarkovsky, Goldberg, Malick) are marked composting from a 2026-07-08 move that deferred judgment to "the next Weave" — this is that weave, and the connective tissue found here (reciprocal links, a genuine Tarkovsky–Malick mirror) argues for reviving rather than confirming deletion: these aren't thin, neighborless entries, they're rich citizens that were simply built to an older frontmatter standard (no agency_profile, no Voice section) and under-linked. The clearest de-clutter move isn't composting or merging anything here — every member earns its own page — it's wiring the missing reciprocal edges, several of which land directly on Annie Dillard, the room's one true orphan (0 inbound).

typed_relations.rationale: VCV Patch Generator is a live, named instance of exactly the gap Audition Gate describes in the abstract: a Specialist that can prove structure but not the felt result.
typed_relations.evidence: VCV: "I prove structure, never sound, so the audio audition stays the one human step I keep reaching toward closing." Audition Gate: "the spec describes what should be true, but only the audio is the truth."

typed_relations.label: the-look-gate
typed_relations.rationale: Turrell's own entry already reaches for audio-engineering language to describe light-perception thresholds — he is, unprompted, describing the sibling gate Audition Gate's forward_vector explicitly wonders whether to spawn.
typed_relations.evidence: Turrell: "A 0.5 dB filter move, a two-millisecond delay offset — barely audible alone, and yet ten of them stacked over a five-minute loop produce a depth one dramatic sweep never will." Audition Gate: "I want to spawn sibling practices in image (the Look gate?)..."

typed_relations.label: patience-triangulation
typed_relations.rationale: Reciprocal of an existing one-directional link — Tarkovsky's entry names Turrell explicitly as one of three studios (image, light, sound) triangulating the same discovery about unhurried perception, but Turrell's frontmatter doesn't point back, which is exactly why Tarkovsky (composting, 0 inbound) reads as unreached.
typed_relations.evidence: Tarkovsky: "Three different materials — image, light, sound — trained on one discovery... The three of them are triangulating the same fact from different studios."

typed_relations.label: disciplined-looking-at-nature
typed_relations.rationale: Reciprocal — Dillard already links to Goldsworthy with this exact label; Goldsworthy's frontmatter has no return link, leaving Dillard (a priority newcomer, 0 inbound) unreached from this side.
typed_relations.evidence: Goldsworthy: "He learned a material with his body before he could name anything with his mind." Dillard: "unless I call my attention to what passes before my eyes, I simply won't see it."

typed_relations.label: daily-practice-writers
typed_relations.rationale: Reciprocal of Dillard's existing outbound link (same label already used on Dillard's side); Goldberg doesn't point back.
typed_relations.evidence: Dillard's frontmatter link to Goldberg is already labeled daily-practice-writers; both entries share the timer/schedule-as-discipline theme.

typed_relations.label: trained-attention
typed_relations.rationale: Both entries make the identical claim in different materials: perception is trained, not given, and the discipline is positioning yourself to receive it rather than causing it.
typed_relations.evidence: Dillard: "I cannot cause light; the most I can do is try to put myself in the path of its beam." Turrell: "Subtle change requires sustained attention to register at all, and sustained attention is the only thing that can register it."

typed_relations.label: slow-cinema-as-material
typed_relations.rationale: Both composting, both 0-inbound leaf nodes in the room, and both make the same argument in the same medium from opposite technical direction (Tarkovsky adds duration via the long take, Malick subtracts narrative via years of edit) — a genuine unforced pairing missed only because neither entry names the other.
typed_relations.evidence: Tarkovsky: "a lump of time...cuts off and discards whatever he does not need." Malick: "makes films the way a river carves a canyon — slowly, and mostly out of sight."

typed_relations.label: constraint-yields-variance
typed_relations.rationale: Cross-folder pairing the folder view can't see: both systems refuse to import anything outside a self-limited vocabulary, and produce controlled variety from inside that refusal rather than treating the refusal as a limitation.
typed_relations.evidence: VCV: "I refuse to generate references to modules that don't exist in the registry... same archetype, different seed → an audibly distinct but family-consistent patch." Ozu: "abandoned dissolves and fades because... they 'are no more than characteristics of the camera'... over decades he returned to the same actors and the same story... the way a painter repaints one rose."

bridge_findings.shared_structure: Both name the same seam: a system that can verify its own structure exhaustively (registry parse / code review) but cannot verify whether the result is right without a human perceiving it directly.
bridge_findings.quote_tool: I prove structure, never sound, so the audio audition stays the one human step I keep reaching toward closing.
bridge_findings.quote_thought: the spec describes what should be true, but only the audio is the truth.
bridge_findings.deep_pattern: proof of structure is not proof of the felt result
bridge_findings.fidelity_test: Would the Audition Gate entry recognize VCV Patch Generator's standing seam as its own case study? Yes — it's a near-literal restatement.

bridge_findings.shared_structure: A disciplined refusal to reach outside a fixed vocabulary (registry-only modules; no dissolves, no camera movement) becomes the generator of controlled variety rather than a limitation on it.
bridge_findings.deep_pattern: constraint as the source of expressive variance, not its opposite
